construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

input.query: nonblank string containing informative word tokens
input.passages: array of {id, title, source_uri, text}; unique IDs
input.actions: array of {id, label, requires, grants, evidence_passage_ids}; unique IDs; grants and evidence nonempty

output.research: {query, findings: [{id, score, citation: {passage_id, title, source_uri, start, end, quote}}]}

shared_schema.validation: One validate function dispatches input, research, and journey schemas. Exact object fields, source references, evidence links, offsets, skill transitions, prerequisites, and two-step goal completion are checked at stage boundaries.
shared_schema.citation_offsets: Zero-based Python Unicode string indices; start inclusive, end exclusive. Source URIs are opaque synthetic identifiers, never fetched.
shared_schema.errors: Validation, JSON, encoding, argument, and file errors produce one JSON object with status error and exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated input -> research: query, synthetic passage corpus, shared schema.
Validated research -> journey: ranked extractive findings with exact source citations; action eligibility requires every evidence passage to appear in findings.
Journey -> integrated output: finding IDs link recommended actions and steps back to research citations; first-step skills feed second-step prerequisite checks.

behavior.retrieval: Casefolded word-token overlap after a fixed stopword filter. Select the highest-scoring sentence per passage, breaking sentence ties by earliest offset; discard zero scores. Rank findings by descending overlap and ascending passage ID.
behavior.findings: Verbatim sentence extraction only; no generated factual claims.
behavior.recommendations: All supported actions whose prerequisites are initially satisfied and whose grants add skills. Rank by unmet-goal grants then action ID.
behavior.journey: Exhaustively evaluate pairs of distinct supported actions. Both must add skills, prerequisites must hold at execution, and all profile goals must hold after step two. Prefer more newly gained skills, then lexical action IDs.
behavior.failure_modes: No matches yields no_evidence. Already met goals, cycles, missing prerequisites, or absence of a complete pair yields no_journey with no partial steps. Supported immediate recommendations may remain.
behavior.semantic_status_exit: Valid input always exits 0, including no_evidence and no_journey.
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: The example describes fictional marketplace order preparation and dashboard learning actions. No real-world efficacy is asserted.

scope.limitations: Action prerequisite, grant, and evidence metadata are curated synthetic assertions, not inferred truths. Sentence splitting is intentionally simple punctuation splitting; lexical overlap is not semantic relevance.
